phrases.phrase: Enlistment applications waiting for a clerk to pick up
{title} has been sitting in the enlistment queue past the deadline with no clerk on it. Please pick it up.
Thanks for enlisting with the 7th Cavalry. Your application is still in the queue, and a member of the processing team will review it soon. You don't need to do anything for now.
Scan the enlistment queue for un-actioned applications
Bot user ID
Reminder deadline (hours)
Enlistment queue node ID
Re-enlistment clerk position IDs
Re-enlistment prefix IDs
Standard enlistment clerk position IDs
Standard enlistment prefix IDs
The XenForo user ID the reminder note is posted as. Default: 598.

How many hours an application may sit in the queue with no clerk reply before it is reminded. The minimum is 1 hour; 0 or lower falls back to the default of 24 so the reminder cannot fire on the whole queue at once.

The forum node whose open applications the reminder scans (the Enlistment Papers queue). Only threads directly in this node are checked; the Completed and Denied child forums are left alone. Default: 325.

Roster position IDs alerted about un-actioned re-enlistments: by default the Re-Enlistment Processing Clerk and the Senior and Lead clerks. Holders are matched as a primary or a secondary seat. A reply from any processing clerk, in either set, still counts as a pickup. Enter one ID per line or separate with commas. Default: 579, 960, 1012.

The thread prefix IDs that mark a re-enlistment. A queue thread carrying one of these as its primary prefix is routed to the re-enlistment clerks. Enter one ID per line or separate with commas. Default: 58.

Roster position IDs alerted about un-actioned standard enlistments: by default the Enlistment Processing Clerk, Processing Clerk IT, and the Senior and Lead clerks. Holders are matched as a primary or a secondary seat. A reply from any processing clerk, in either set, counts as the application being picked up and stops the reminder. Enter one ID per line or separate with commas. Default: 579, 580, 751, 1012.

The thread prefix IDs that mark a standard enlistment. A queue thread carrying one of these as its primary prefix is routed to the standard clerks. Enter one ID per line or separate with commas. Default: 57.
Enlistment Reminder
Reminds the processing team about enlistment applications that have sat in the queue past the deadline with no clerk reply.
